actual: The committed Rotation L2 repository validates prediction_id as uuid.UUID and passes it directly to psycopg2. Fix the HMM persistence boundary without changing the accepted zero-fit model contract, dataset, run identity, API semantics, or production/runtime state; add RED-to-GREEN coverage and preserve fail-closed/idempotent readback.
